counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (was true). This disables actuated extension/hold logic so cycle is fixed-time; EW green then terminates at its green_seconds and NS gets service, preventing 200s starvation. Same steps, same detector_fail event, no violation.

explanation: EW green started around step 145 and never terminated, stuck green for ~196s continuous (from ~150 to 346), far beyond max_green_seconds 87. The detector_fail on E beginning at t=203 appears to break actuated logic: controller keeps EW green even though E queue is 0 (invisible) and W still queued, while NS accumulates >200s wait. Fixed-time (actuated=false) cycles normally, so bug is in actuated max-green / recall handling when a detector fails - it should force switch at max_green or when other direction waited long, but instead holds green indefinitely.
